# Schema Inference Engine Overview

The Schema Inference Engine, also known by its aliases `sie` or `schema-inferer`, is a component designed to enrich metadata by automatically detecting and documenting structural schemas. As a key part of Metadata Enrichment Frameworks, it plays a crucial role in understanding and organizing data.

This engine specifically focuses on inferring schemas from unstructured or semi-structured datasets, providing valuable structural information where explicit schema definitions may be absent.

# Semantic Tagging Service Overview

The Semantic Tagging Service (also known as STS or Semantic Tagger) is an AI-powered service designed to apply semantic tags and taxonomies to raw data assets. Its primary purpose is to enhance the discoverability of these data assets by providing rich, meaningful categorization.

The Data Classification Pipeline (DCP), also known as the data classifier, is an automated pipeline designed to categorize data. Its primary function involves classifying data based on its sensitivity, domain, and applicable governance policies.
